A. ALL DEVICE MOUNTING HEIGHTS INDICATED ON THIS LEGEND ARE FROM FINISHED
FLOOR TO CENTER OF OUTLET BOX.
B. PROVIDE #10 WIRE FOR ALL 20A 120V CIRCUITS EXCEEDING 100 FEET AND FOR 20A 277V
CIRCUITS THAT EXCEED 200 FEET.
C. RECEPTACLES SHALL BE WIRED AS FOLLOWS: 3 CIRCUIT, 20A, HOMERUNS TO PANELS
SHALL BE 3#12 PHASE CONDUCTORS, 3#12 NEUTRAL CONDUCTORS AND 1#12 GROUND.
2 CIRCUIT, 20A, HOMERUNS TO PANELS SHALL BE 2#12 PHASE CONDUCTORS, 2#12
NEUTRAL CONDUCTORS, AND 1 #12 GROUND. 1 CIRCUIT, 20A, HOMERUNS TO PANEL
SHALL BE 1#12 PHASE CONDUCTOR, 1#12 NEUTRAL CONDUCTOR AND 1#12 GROUND.
D. VERIFY LOCATION AND CONNECTIONS REQUIREMENTS FOR EQUIPMENT PROVIDED BY
OTHER TRADES PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.
E. COORDINATE CEILING MOUNTED LIGHTS AND DEVICES WITH CEILING CONTRACTOR
AND INSTALL AS SHOWN ON THE REFLECTED CEILING PLANS.
F. ALL FLOOR MOUNTED ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT (SWITCHGEAR, FREE STANDING
PANELBOARDS, TRANSFORMERS) SHALL BE INSTALLED ON 4" HIGH CONCRETE PAD.
G. COORDINATE ALL DIMENSIONS & WIRING REQUIREMENTS ON ALL PRE-PURCHASED
EQUIPMENT WITH FINAL APPROVED SHOP DWGS.
H. FIRE SEAL ALL CONDUIT PENETRATIONS THROUGH FIRE RATED WALLS & SLABS. SEAL
FIRE RATING SHALL BE EQUAL TO OR GREATER THAN THE FIRE RATING OF THE WALL
OR SLAB THROUGH WHICH THE CONDUIT PASSES.
I. COORDINATE THE LOCATION AND MOUNTING HEIGHTS OF OUTLETS AND MULTI-OUTLET
ASSEMBLIES WITH ARCHITECTURAL FLOOR PLANS AND ELEVATION DRAWINGS.
J. CONTRACTOR SHALL VERIFY ALL DOOR SWINGS BEFORE INSTALLING SWITCH BOXES.
K. COORDINATE EXACT LOCATION OF SUSPENDED LIGHTING FIXTURES IN MECHANICAL
AND STORAGE AREAS WITH OTHER TRADES. MOUNT FIXTURES SO AS TO PROVIDE
MAXIMUM AND UNIFORM LIGHT COVERAGE IN SPACE.
L. RACEWAYS, SLEEVES, AND BOXES FOR IT CABLING SHALL COMPLY WITH COMMERCIAL
BUILDING STANDARD FOR TELECOMMUNICATION PATHWAYS AND SPACES,
ANSI/TIA/EIA-569-A.
M. BOND FLAMMABLE LIQUID STORAGE CABINETS WITH #10 AWG WIRE TO THE NEAREST
STEEL COLUMN. INSTALL WIRE IN CONDUIT.

A. REFER TO ARCHITECTURAL DRAWINGS AND ELEVATIONS FOR EXACT LUMINAIRE
LOCATIONS, ORIENTATIONS, MOUNTING HEIGHTS, ALIGNMENTS, AND VISIBLE FINISHES.
COORDINATE LUMINAIRES, MOUNTING CHANNELS, BRACKETS, CONDUIT, JUNCTION
BOXES, AND ASSOCIATED ACCESSORIES WITH THE ARCHITECT AND OTHER TRADES
PRIOR TO FINAL ORDERING AND INSTALLATION.
B. FIELD VERIFY ALL MOUNTING CONDITIONS, DIMENSIONS, EQUIPMENT LOCATIONS,
CABLE ROUTES, ACCESS REQUIREMENTS, AND LINEAR LUMINAIRE LENGTHS PRIOR TO
FABRICATION OR ORDERING. LENGTHS STATED AS PART OF LUMINAIRE TAGS ARE NOT
INTENDED TO BE USED AS ORDERING DIMENSIONS.
C. SUBMIT COORDINATED SHOP DRAWINGS SHOWING LUMINAIRE LAYOUTS, SECTION
LENGTHS, FEED LOCATIONS, MOUNTING DETAILS, CONTROL ZONES, POWER SUPPLIES,
CONTROLLERS, CONNECTIONS, CABLE ROUTES, AND EQUIPMENT ACCESS POINTS.
D. COORDINATE CANOPY LUMINAIRE LOCATIONS, SUPPORTS, FEED POINTS,
CONNECTIONS, AND ACCESS REQUIREMENTS WITH THE CANOPY CONSTRUCTION. DO
NOT DRILL, CUT, OR PENETRATE CANOPY COMPONENTS UNTIL LOCATIONS HAVE BEEN
COORDINATED WITH THE ARCHITECT AND ENGINEER.
E. ROUTE WIRE AND CONDUIT CONCEALED UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED. CONDUIT IN
EXPOSED AREAS SHALL BE RUN IN STRAIGHT LINES PARALLEL TO OR AT RIGHT ANGLES
TO BUILDING LINES AND PAINTED TO MATCH ARCHITECTURAL FINISH SCHEDULES.
INCLUDE ALL ASSOCIATED COSTS IN THE PROJECT BID.
F. SEAL CONDUIT AND CABLE PENETRATIONS THROUGH WALLS, CEILINGS, FLOORS,
CANOPIES, AND EXTERIOR CONSTRUCTION TO MAINTAIN REQUIRED FIRE, WEATHER,
AND ENVIRONMENTAL RATINGS. REFER TO ARCHITECTURAL DRAWINGS FOR
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS.
G. PROVIDE SEPARATE NEUTRAL FOR EACH CIRCUIT.
H. INSTALL CONTINUOUS LINEAR LUMINAIRES IN STRAIGHT, LEVEL, AND UNINTERRUPTED
ROWS, PARALLEL WITH ADJACENT ARCHITECTURAL ELEMENTS, WITH CONSISTENT
LENS ALIGNMENT, JOINT SPACING, AND MOUNTING OFFSETS. PROVIDE NO GAPS
BETWEEN LUMINAIRE SECTIONS. THE MAXIMUM PERMITTED NON-ILLUMINATED LENGTH
AT EITHER END OF A RUN SHALL NOT EXCEED 6 INCHES.
I. PROVIDE A COMPLETE AND FULLY FUNCTIONAL RGBW DMX-CONTROLLED DYNAMIC
EXTERIOR LINEAR LIGHTING SYSTEM, INCLUDING ALL MANUFACTURER-REQUIRED
POWER SUPPLIES, CONTROLLERS, GATEWAYS, DATA DISTRIBUTION EQUIPMENT,
SPLITTERS, REPEATERS, TERMINATION DEVICES, CABLING, CONNECTIONS,
ACCESSORIES, ADDRESSING, AND PROGRAMMING.
J. COMPLY WITH MANUFACTURER-PUBLISHED LIMITATIONS FOR LUMINAIRE RUN
LENGTHS, POWER-SUPPLY LOADING, REMOTE MOUNTING DISTANCES, CONDUCTOR
SIZES, VOLTAGE DROP, DMX CABLE LENGTHS, CONTROL TOPOLOGY, AND QUANTITY OF
DEVICES PER CONTROL SEGMENT. PROVIDE SHIELDED DMX DATA CABLING AND
MANUFACTURER-APPROVED CONNECTIONS. WIRE-NUT CONNECTIONS SHALL NOT BE
USED FOR DMX DATA WIRING.
K. LOCATE POWER SUPPLIES, CONTROLLERS, GATEWAYS, DATA DISTRIBUTION
EQUIPMENT, JUNCTION BOXES, AND CONNECTIONS IN ACCESSIBLE, VENTILATED, AND
SERVICEABLE LOCATIONS. CONCEALED EQUIPMENT SHALL REMAIN ACCESSIBLE
WITHOUT REMOVAL OF OR DAMAGE TO PERMANENT ARCHITECTURAL CONSTRUCTION.
L. PROVIDE LUMINAIRES, POWER EQUIPMENT, CONNECTORS, CABLES, SPLICES, AND
ACCESSORIES LISTED AND RATED FOR THE INSTALLED ENVIRONMENT. INSTALL
EXTERIOR EQUIPMENT TO PREVENT THE ACCUMULATION OR ENTRY OF WATER.
PROVIDE REQUIRED GASKETS, SEALS, END CAPS, DRAINAGE, DRIP LOOPS, AND
WEATHERPROOF CONNECTIONS, AND MAINTAIN THE MANUFACTURER’S REQUIRED
ENVIRONMENTAL RATING AT ALL CONNECTIONS, END CONDITIONS, AND FIELD
PENETRATIONS.
M. INSTALL RGBW COLOR-CHANGING LUMINAIRES END-TO-END IN CONTINUOUS RUNS PER
MANUFACTURER’S RECOMMENDATIONS AND INSTALLATION REQUIREMENTS. MAINTAIN
MINIMUM REQUIRED GAPS BETWEEN LUMINAIRE LENSES AS REQUIRED BY
MANUFACTURER FOR DURABILITY AND PRODUCT INTEGRITY, WHILE MAINTAINING A
CONTINUOUS, UNIFORM APPEARANCE ALONG THE ENTIRE RUN.
N. INSTALL, CONNECT, ADDRESS, PROGRAM, START UP, TEST, AND COMMISSION THE
COMPLETE LIGHTING AND CONTROL SYSTEM IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE
MANUFACTURER’S PUBLISHED INSTRUCTIONS. PROVIDE MANUFACTURER-
RECOMMENDED CONFIGURATION, PROGRAMMING, AND STARTUP SERVICES REQUIRED
FOR A COMPLETE AND FULLY FUNCTIONAL SYSTEM.
O. COORDINATE CONTROL ZONES, NORMAL OPERATING SCHEDULES, APPROVED COLOR-
CHANGING SCENES, DEFAULT STARTUP CONDITIONS, MANUAL OVERRIDES, AND
SYSTEM RESPONSE FOLLOWING LOSS AND RESTORATION OF POWER WITH THE
OWNER. PROGRAM AND LOCK MAXIMUM LUMINAIRE OUTPUT LEVELS AS REQUIRED TO
COMPLY WITH APPROVED PHOTOMETRIC CALCULATIONS AND APPLICABLE EXTERIOR-
LIGHTING LIMITATIONS. MAXIMUM PROGRAMMED OUTPUT SHALL NOT BE INCREASED
WITHOUT WRITTEN APPROVAL FROM THE OWNER AND ENGINEER.
P. PRIOR TO FINAL PROGRAMMING AND COMMISSIONING, CONDUCT A PRELIMINARY
REVIEW MEETING WITH THE ARCHITECT, ENGINEER, AND OWNER TO REVIEW THE
LIGHTING INSTALLATION, ALIGNMENT, CONTROL ZONES, COLOR-CHANGING
PROGRAMMING, OPERATING SCHEDULES, OUTPUT LEVELS, AND SYSTEM
FUNCTIONALITY. INCORPORATE APPROVED REVISIONS PRIOR TO FINAL
COMMISSIONING.
Q. AT PROJECT COMPLETION, PROVIDE THE OWNER WITH FINAL DMX ADDRESSING,
CONTROL-ZONE ASSIGNMENTS, SYSTEM RISER DIAGRAMS, EQUIPMENT SETTINGS,
OPERATING SCHEDULES, APPROVED SCENE PROGRAMMING, SOFTWARE AND
CONFIGURATION FILES, REQUIRED ACCESS CREDENTIALS, AND MANUFACTURER
OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE DOCUMENTATION.
R. PROVIDE ON-SITE TRAINING FOR OWNER-DESIGNATED PERSONNEL COVERING SYSTEM
OPERATION, SCHEDULE MODIFICATION, SCENE SELECTION, MANUAL OVERRIDE, BASIC
TROUBLESHOOTING, AND SYSTEM SHUTDOWN AND RESTART PROCEDURES.
S. INCLUDE ONE ADDITIONAL ON-SITE PROGRAMMING SESSION AFTER INITIAL SYSTEM
ACCEPTANCE TO ADJUST OPERATING SCHEDULES, OUTPUT LEVELS, COLOR-CHANGING
SCENES, AND OWNER PREFERENCES.
